summary: 125 canonical Node tests passed, with zero failures, cancellations or skips. The real desktop global preflight ran. assertions.evidence: Runner exit 0; actual Node summary tests=125, pass=125, fail=0, cancelled=0, skipped=0, todo=0. Raw log SHA 832eb5d14ed30d5cf15f1cbbed8a35196a70f890665bb96f75cef5e58c19f14a.

Real Linux linkage branch uses the maintained OCI inventory helper. ARM64 and AMD64 controls admit target headers and reject foreign extensionless odiff/arbitrary deep paths, non-executable ELFs, malformed class/endian/truncated headers and escaping links. Contained link positive control passes.

The real installed lost-pixel comparator eagerly imports the byte-identical pruned odiff JS wrapper, then compares black versus white PNGs via pixelmatch and writes the difference. execFile is a throwing negative control; no native odiff dispatch occurs.

Top-level odiff 2.6.1 and nested odiff 2.5.0 retain package identity and JS while their unused bin, platform-* and _export payloads are removed. Source donors remain intact. Existing nested posthog/rusha and required/optional dependency controls pass. A different-package prune is refused.

Receipt independently binds verifier, manifest writer and ELF inventory helper. Stage identity also binds the helper and rejects changed helper bytes on resume. Existing target loader, addon library/runpath, factory, allocator and stage-resume controls pass.
